preRegistrationValues.nonDiagnosticPurpose: Deliver public support and contribution entry points that a person can use without first learning Codex, Git, repository revision lookup, commands, Harness criteria, or causal-program syntax. The usable intake text is the primary result; the task is not created to exercise or diagnose the Harness.

demandEntry.demand: Assume the user knows nothing about Codex and help them reach the result from zero at every point instead of teaching them which capability, command, configuration, or workflow to operate.
demandEntry.observedRepositoryProblem: At commit a2d291f0cbe5a53d1c5beb68ae1591efd5bdfdce, SUPPORT.md and SUPPORT.zh-CN.md require the reporter to identify an exact revision, affected artifact, evidence class, reproduction commands, and sanitization route, while CONTRIBUTING.md requires a product contributor to formulate O/G mappings, a causal hypothesis, falsifier, lifecycle boundaries, and verification commands before maintainers bind the work.

goalAndBoundedAuthority.goal: Rewrite only CONTRIBUTING.md, SUPPORT.md, and SUPPORT.zh-CN.md so a person enters with their goal, observed behavior, expected result, relevant facts they already know, and sensitivity warning; the Agent or maintainer owns safely discoverable revision, artifact, command, route, causal-program, verification, and cleanup mechanics.

goalAndBoundedAuthority.excludedOperations: No installation, Hook or plugin enablement, account connection, external issue creation, external write, publication, release, deployment, new model dispatch, branch, worktree, repository fork, conversation fork, or new task.
